name: Second Wind
description: On your turn, use a bonus action to heal 1d10 + your fighter level hit points.
Once used, you need a short or long rest before using it again.

name: Action Surge
uses: Per short or long rest, see Uses
description: On your turn, take one extra action in addition to your normal action and any bonus action.
Needs a short or long rest to use again. From level 17 you get two uses between rests, but only one per turn.

name: Indomitable
description: When you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it. You must keep the new roll.
Each use needs a long rest to recover. See Uses for how many uses you have.

name: Protection
trigger: An enemy you can see attacks someone else within 5 ft
description: Shield in hand, you can throw off attacks on allies beside you. If a creature you can see attacks another target within 5 ft of you, spend your reaction: that attack roll has disadvantage.

name: Defense
description: You get +1 AC for as long as you are wearing armor. Always on; it stops working when you take the armor off.

name: Weapon Bond
description: A 1-hour ritual (a short rest works) ties you to one weapon. Keep it within reach throughout, and touch it at the end to seal the bond.
A bonded weapon cannot be disarmed from you unless you are incapacitated. While it is on your plane, you can call it to your hand as a bonus action on your turn; it teleports there instantly.
You can have up to 2 bonded weapons, but summon only one per bonus action. Bonding a third needs you to break one existing bond first.

name: Superiority Dice
uses: Refill on short or long rest
description: Your pool of special dice that pay for maneuvers. Spend 1 die per maneuver, and use only one maneuver on each attack. Every spent die comes back after a short or long rest.
Maneuver save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice).
You know 3 maneuvers at level 3, and learn 2 more at levels 7, 10 and 15. You may swap one maneuver whenever you learn new ones.

name: Know Your Enemy
description: Study or chat with a creature for 1 minute or more, away from combat. The DM tells you whether it ranks above, below or level with you in 2 traits you pick. Options: any of the 3 physical scores, AC, current HP, overall class levels, or fighter levels.

name: Relentless
trigger: You roll initiative with 0 superiority dice
description: Roll initiative with every superiority die spent, and you get 1 die back.

name: War Magic
trigger: You cast a cantrip with your action
description: Cast a cantrip as your action, and you may follow it with 1 weapon attack as a bonus action.

name: Eldritch Strike
trigger: You hit with a weapon attack
description: A creature you hit with a weapon attack suffers disadvantage on its next save against one of your spells. The spell must land before your next turn ends.

name: Arcane Charge
description: Action Surge now comes with a blink: teleport up to 30 ft into an unoccupied space you can see, either before or after the extra action.

name: Improved War Magic
trigger: You cast a spell with your action
description: After you use your action to cast any spell, make 1 weapon attack as a bonus action.

name: Archery
description: You get +2 to attack rolls made with ranged weapons. It is always on, so there is nothing to activate.

name: Dueling
description: Holding a melee weapon in one hand with no other weapon in your other hand gives you +2 to damage rolls with it.

name: Great Weapon Fighting
description: Wielding a melee weapon with two hands, if a damage die shows 1 or 2 you may roll it again, and the second result stands even if it is low too. Only weapons that are two-handed or versatile qualify.

name: Two-Weapon Fighting
description: When fighting with two weapons, your second attack also adds your ability modifier to its damage.

name: Commander's Strike
description: When you take the Attack action, trade one of your swings for a bonus action that sends a friendly creature who sees or hears you into battle. Spend the die: that creature uses its reaction for one weapon attack, with the die added to the damage.

name: Disarming Attack
description: The die joins the damage roll. Name an item the target holds; it must pass a Strength save or let go, and the item falls at its feet.
DC: 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Str or Dex modifier.

name: Distracting Strike
description: The die joins the damage roll, and you open the target up for your friends: until your next turn starts, the first attack roll someone else makes against it has advantage.

name: Evasive Footwork
description: When you move, roll the die and add the result to your AC. The bonus lasts until you stop moving.

name: Feinting Attack
description: Use a bonus action to feint at a creature within 5 feet. Your next attack roll against it has advantage, and if that attack hits you add the die to the damage.

name: Goading Attack
description: The die joins the damage roll, and the target must pass a Wisdom save or fixate on you. Until your next turn ends, it rolls with disadvantage when it attacks anyone but you.
DC: 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Str or Dex modifier.

name: Lunging Attack
trigger: You make a melee attack on your turn
description: Your reach for that one attack grows by 5 feet. If it hits, add the die to the damage.

name: Maneuvering Attack
description: The die joins the damage roll. An ally who can see or hear you may then use its reaction for a move of up to half its speed, and your target can't make opportunity attacks against it for that move.

name: Menacing Attack
description: The die joins the damage roll, and the target must pass a Wisdom save or be frightened of you. The fear lasts until your next turn ends.
DC: 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Str or Dex modifier.

name: Parry
trigger: Another creature damages you with a melee attack
description: When another creature hits you with a melee attack, spend a reaction and the die to cut the damage by the die roll plus your Dexterity modifier.

name: Precision Attack
trigger: You make a weapon attack roll
description: Add the die to the attack roll. You can do this before or after rolling, but before the attack's effects are applied.

name: Pushing Attack
description: The die joins the damage roll. A Large or smaller target must pass a Strength save or you shove it up to 15 ft straight away from you.
DC: 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Str or Dex modifier.

name: Rally
description: On your turn, spend a bonus action to steady an ally who can see or hear you. Roll the die; the ally gets that many temporary hit points plus your Charisma modifier.

name: Riposte
description: Strike back at the creature that missed: one melee weapon attack against it. On a hit, the die joins the damage roll.

name: Sweeping Attack
description: Carry the swing into a second creature that is within 5 ft of the first target and within your reach. Compare your original attack roll to its AC; if that roll would hit it, it takes damage equal to the die, of the original attack's damage type.

name: Trip Attack
description: The die joins the damage roll. A Large or smaller target must pass a Strength save or fall prone.
DC: 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Str or Dex modifier.
